liveExecutionReason: A server-side Betfair Exchange auto-bet placer is now installed and wired to AU V11 locked signals, but it is deliberately locked because Betfair live credentials are not configured, server enable is OFF and the kill switch is ON.

architecture.serverReason: A phone/browser can sleep, close, lose connectivity or suspend background JavaScript. Server integrity checks, shadow evaluation, optional auto-placement and post-race state tracking run independently.

preflight.failureRule: If preflight is missing, stale, blocked or errors, a green AU BET NOW instruction is invalid and auto-placement is blocked.

nearJumpBurst.purpose: Once a watched race is within three minutes, the server performs short high-frequency checks so the 20s→10s V11 window is not dependent on a one-minute cron tick.

shadowBackend.note: The worker now calls the server-side placer when a genuine BET_LOCKED signal exists. The placer itself remains locked unless its independent controls and credentials pass.

autoBetPlacer.unknownSubmissionRule: If a provider submission times out, query Betfair by deterministic customer order reference. If no matched order can be proven, mark UNKNOWN_PROVIDER_RESULT and do not automatically retry.

stateTracker.stateRule: Favourite WIN resets state to 0; favourite LOSS increments state by 1. State tracking is independent from whether a system wager was placed.

crossSourceVerification.conflictRule: If sources disagree on favourite identity but imply the same W/L outcome, record the unambiguous outcome and audit both names. If they imply different outcomes, do not guess: mark REVIEW_REQUIRED and leave the state unresolved.
